xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3116: scripts/file-size-baseline.txt is a cross-branch serialization point — every concurrent branch conflicts on the same 31 lines

plan.title: Derive the file-size ratchet from origin/main; delete the committed baseline
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: scripts/file-size-baseline.txt is shared mutable state committed to the repo: lint-file-size.sh fails on stale entries, so any branch changing a god file's line count must edit the same 31-line file. 71 commits touched it in 7 days; PAN-3037 and PAN-1696 both conflicted on it in RUN-71 (PAN-1696's only conflict). Two branches that each shrink a DIFFERENT god file still conflict because both rewrite the snapshot.
narratives.Proposal: Derive, don't store: lint-file-size.sh compares working-tree line counts against origin/main (FILE_SIZE_BASE_REF override) at lint time — allowed = max(CEILING=1000, count on base ref), allowlist entries in the new scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt ('<lines> <path> # <ISSUE-REF>') permit audited growth. Delete scripts/file-size-baseline.txt, the --update mode, file-size-reconcile.ts + its uat-promote wiring, the deferred-file-size-ratchet quality-lint rule, and retarget lint-ratchet-audit.sh at the allowlist. Full decision rules and before/after core logic are in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-3116.md) — follow it exactly.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Splitting or refactoring any god file
- Changing the 1000-line ceiling or extending the guard outside src/
- Auto-pruning moot allowlist entries
- scripts/lint-dashboard-types.sh's separate baseline contract
- Migrating historical docs/journals that mention the old baseline (FLYWHEEL-STATE.md, flywheel-briefs/, B-deacon-decomp.md)
- Retrofitting the new contract into already-active xBRIEF plans on other branches
- Committing .pan/context/codebase/ files (untracked on main since PAN-2541; deliberately skipped)

autoDecisions.summary: Compare against origin/main (env-overridable via FILE_SIZE_BASE_REF), hard-failing when the ref is unresolvable
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 'git show origin/main:<path> | wc -l' as the fix direction; origin/main is the merge target in every context the lint runs (worktrees, pre-push, CI with fetch-depth: 0). A missing ref must fail loudly (no-bandaids rule), and the env override keeps tests hermetic.

autoDecisions.summary: Allowlist rows require an inline issue ref and malformed rows fail the lint
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes every exception self-documenting at the read site and preserves the old D4 'audited growth with issue reference' property even where the commit-message audit (pre-push range mode) doesn't run.

autoDecisions.summary: No stale-entry failures and no --update mode anywhere in the new design
autoDecisions.rationale: Fail-on-stale is precisely the mechanism that forced every god-file-touching branch to edit shared lint metadata. Removing it is the root-cause fix; moot allowlist entries are harmless and pruned manually.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete file-size-reconcile.ts and the uat-promote amend rather than repurposing them
autoDecisions.rationale: They exist only to keep the stored snapshot fresh. With nothing stored, keeping them is dead code and the uat-promote amend becomes a no-op trigger.

autoDecisions.summary: Update only A3-file-size-guard.md with an Update note; leave historical journals untouched
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the repo convention (B-deacon-decomp.md:26) and the surgical-changes rule — journals record what happened at the time and must not be rewritten.

autoDecisions.summary: Skipped the .pan/context/codebase/ bootstrap the planning template requests
autoDecisions.rationale: .pan/ is untracked on main since the PAN-2541 state migration (cc30721631); the four context files exist untracked at the project root. Re-committing them under .pan/ contradicts the migration direction and is orthogonal to this issue.

items.title: Rewrite lint-file-size.sh to derive from the base ref; delete the baseline; add the allowlist

expected_outputs: lint-file-size.sh exits 0 on this branch with no baseline file present

narrative.Action: Rewrite scripts/lint-file-size.sh per the PRD's 'New core logic' listing: CEILING=1000; BASE_REF=${FILE_SIZE_BASE_REF:-origin/main} with a hard exit-1 (actionable message) when unresolvable; parse scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt rows of '<lines> <path> # <ISSUE-REF>' (blank lines and # comments skipped; any other malformed row fails naming the line); for each non-test src file (keep the existing find enumeration and exclusions verbatim), skip files at/under 1000 lines, else allowed = allowlist value, or max(CEILING, count on base ref) — a file absent from the base ref gets allowed=CEILING so new god files fail. Fail when the working-tree count exceeds allowed, printing the allowlist remedy. No --update mode, no stale-entry checks. In the SAME commit: git rm scripts/file-size-baseline.txt and create scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt with a header comment documenting the format and zero entries. Rewrite tests/unit/scripts/lint-file-size.test.ts: makeTempRepo creates an initial commit of the 'main' state and a 'base' ref (git update-ref refs/heads/base HEAD); runLint passes env { ...process.env, FILE_SIZE_BASE_REF: 'base' }. Cases: new god file fails; over-ceiling file at/below base count passes; growth past base count fails; allowlist entry permits audited growth; malformed allowlist row fails naming the line; missing base ref exits 1 with the actionable message; shrinking a god file requires no metadata edit (assert no baseline file exists in the installed temp repo).

Given an allowlist row '1300 src/foo.ts # PAN-3116', the guard exits 0 at 1300 lines and exits 1 at 1301; a row missing the issue ref exits 1 naming the malformed line
The item's commit deletes scripts/file-size-baseline.txt and creates scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt containing a header comment that documents the '<lines> <path> # <ISSUE-REF>' format

Retarget lint-ratchet-audit.sh from the deleted baseline to the file-size allowlist

expected_outputs: lint-ratchet-audit.sh exits 0 on the current HEAD

narrative.Action: In scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.sh: replace BASELINE="scripts/file-size-baseline.txt" (line 22) with FILE_SIZE_ALLOWLIST="scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt"; rename baseline_at/parent_baseline_at/baseline_increases_for_commit to file-size-allowlist equivalents pointed at the new file — the awk '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && NF >= 2' parsing and the added/raised detection (lines 75-80) work unchanged on '<lines> <path> # <ref>' rows; update the audit loop (line 213) to iterate the new file alongside eslint-any-allowlist.json and circular-deps-baseline.txt; update the header comment to state that additions/raises to the file-size allowlist require an issue-referencing commit while removals and lowerings are free. In tests/unit/scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.test.ts: rewrite the four baseline-specific cases (rise-without-ref fails, rise-with-ref passes, lowerings pass, malformed conflict-marker rows ignored) against scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt; leave the allowlist/circular/rename/root-commit/merge-attribution cases intact. Do not otherwise reformat the script.

Remove the describe block covering the rule in src/lib/xbrief/__tests__/quality-lint.test.ts (~lines 214-283). In src/dashboard/server/routes/__tests__/complete-planning.test.ts remove the assertion pair at lines 353-362 that expects the rule to fire and clear; remove the baseline-reconcile fixture item (~lines 156-181) ONLY if no other assertion in the file consumes it — check before deleting. Rewrite the 'Ratchet-backed verification' paragraph at src/lib/cloister/prompts/planning.md:229 to state: the file-size ratchet is derived not stored — lint-file-size.sh compares working-tree line counts against origin/main at lint time, there is no baseline file to reconcile, items never carry lint metadata in files_scope, and an item that grows a god file past its origin/main count must add an allowlist row ('<lines> <path> # <ISSUE-REF>' in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt) in the same commit. If npm run lint:prompts or lint:prompt-trailer fails on the prompt edit, follow the failing lint's own instructions.
